title: Bulk storage of tires.
officialText:
Buildings and structures where the area for the storage of tires exceeds 500 square feet (47
m2) or 7,500 cubic feet (212 m3) shall be equipped throughout with an automatic sprinkler system in accordance with
Section 903.3.1.1.
